title: Reflective Writing
skills: explain the purpose and characteristics of reflective writing
connect experiences or learning to thoughtful analysis
move beyond summary by examining meaning, growth, and implications
organize reflective responses with clear evidence, insight, and personal reasoning
alignment_note: Introduces reflective writing as a process of examining experiences, learning, decisions, and growth through thoughtful analysis rather than simple summary. Supports metacognition, personal and academic reflection, evidence-based self-assessment, and development of a clear reflective voice across high school English courses.
